Docs Guides

Configuring a Pod

This page shows how to declare a Pod manifest and apply it to a cluster. The manifest below is the minimum viable definition.

The manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:1.29
    ports:
    - containerPort: 80

Applying it

kubectl apply -f pod.yaml
kubectl get pods --namespace default

Reading it back

import requests

r = requests.get('https://example.test/api/pods')
data = r.json()
print(data['items'])

Rust client

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize)]
struct Pod {
    name: String,
}

Inline code in prose

Call r.json() to decode the response body. The field metadata.name is required (nonstandard) on older clusters.

Notes

  • Set imagePullPolicy explicitly in production.
  • The namespace defaults to default when omitted.
